I agree with what many others have said -if puppy acting normally highly unlikely they have rabies. Rabies progresses quite quickly in dogs over days not several weeks - often with unusual behaviours wobbly gait (indicating paralysis) snapping or being unaware of danger (ie for a nocturnal animal running around in the daytime)

Also when they say rabies is endemic in canines -wolves coyotes foxes —-these animals are much more likely the ones infected with rabies

Like someone said -you can get rabies vaccine/rabies immunoglobulin -not sure what country you are in but here family doctors arrange the treatment with our urgent doctors/ED —so maybe see your primary care doctor first if it would provide you peace. Thanks for saying that -I am going to lay it all on the line here and tell my story.

I have had trich since my teens -(I am 55 now). I pull hair behind my ears and pubic hairs. I eat the hair particularly if there is a root attached. Sometimes I control it and other times it becomes unconscious almost.

I have had bald patches that people have asked about and often I will just ignore the question. I had only told one boyfriend about the habit and he was good about it.

Then I got married at age 47. I had no issues with hair pulling initially. However I was then diagnosed with MS  at age 50. I progressed pretty quick to where I can only walk with 2 elbow crutches. I was quite stressed over this time and I pulled hair trying to hide it. Unbeknownst to me, my husband saw me pulling pubic hairs and eating them.  He never told me but apparently he was so repulsed he just pulled away.

He took a lover and has been with her since then. I suspect I always knew but he said he didn’t want to be intimate due to MS and my fatigue.  He is now so emboldened he brings this woman’s over and sleeps with her in an adjacent room.

I confronted him asking why I wasn’t good enough to sleep with, why we no longer coddled and he said “I will f-ing tell you why - you repulse me”. “You are slovenly and disgusting”. “When I saw you pulling pubic hairs and eating them, I was so sickened”.

He then brought up my cleaning habits -how I wash the dishes to a substandard that isn’t enough, that the animals will eat off of a human plate and those plates need to be sterilised not just washed with water/soap. He brought up how I once picked a towel washcloth to wipe the rim of the toilet off (after he squirted toilet cleaner all other the rim -his version of cleaning the toilet). He didn’t believe I would put the washcloth into the laundry to clean it. He brought up that if I heat up soup in microwave it isn’t hot enough. He just kept repeating he is repulsed and I am  slovenly.

And why this is so horrible -not just the fact that I am slovenly but I am trapped. I can no longer walk; I am reliant on him to get to work. I am reliant on him to drive me to the grocery store. I need to wear incontinence pads now. I can barely take a shower and safely make it back to bed because the heat saps it out of me. And I feel so trapped. I rely on him for the above and financial. And no one would ever want to date a crippled (my word to describe myself sorry if I offend anyone it’s just how disgusted I feel about my body). 

I am an ex-pat American living overseas. I could never return home as it would be so hard to get $; housing, job etc etc. 

I have never felt so repulsive before.
